channel.title: K C B Inc - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: Pentagon releases names of first U.S. service members killed in Iran war
item.description: Six American service members have been killed in the U.S.-Iran conflict, U.S. Central Command said.

item.title: 11/03/2024: Election Truth; Unintended Consequences; The Land of Novo
item.description: First, how Georgia election officials fight voting misinformation. Then, a look at the consequences of Texas' strict abortion laws. And, meet the Novo Nordisk scientist behind Ozempic, Wegovy.

item.title: Laurie Buckhout projected to win GOP primary in redrawn N.C. district
item.description: Buckhout narrowly lost to Democratic Rep. Don Davis in 2024.

item.title: Texas GOP Senate primary heading to Cornyn-Paxton runoff, CBS News projects
item.description: In the Texas GOP Senate primary, CBS News projects Sen. John Cornyn and Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton will go to a runoff, with neither clearing 50% of the vote.

item.title: Bobby Pulido wins Democratic primary in Texas' 15th District, CBS News projects
item.description: CBS News projects Bobby Pulido wins Texas' 15th Congressional District, setting up battle against Republican incumbent Rep. Monica De La Cruz.

item.title: Trump defends war with Iran as conflict widens
item.description: Israel sent troops into Lebanon as the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran widened, and some of Iran's Gulf neighbors warned that Iran's retaliatory fire could draw them into the spreading conflict.

item.title: GOP Rep. Dan Crenshaw loses primary to Texas state Rep. Steve Toth, CBS News projects
item.description: Republican Rep. Dan Crenshaw of Texas lost his primary race to Republican state Rep. Steve Toth.

item.title: 3/3: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump says almost "everything's been knocked out" as Iran unleashes drones; Mini miracle on the Hudson as pilot and passenger survive plane crash in icy river.

item.title: Critical primaries held in Texas, North Carolina and Arkansas
item.description: Voters headed to the polls Tuesday in Texas, North Carolina and Arkansas, marking the start of the 2026 midterm cycle.

item.title: GOP Rep. Tony Gonzales forced into primary runoff after affair allegations shake up race
item.description: Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales of Texas and gun activist Brandon Herrera are locked in a tight primary battle, as Gonzales faces calls to resign after being accused of having an affair with an aide who later died by suicide.
